name: BioASQ
intro: BioASQ 首届挑战包含两个生物医学任务：Task 1a 要求在人工编目之前为新 MEDLINE 记录预测 MeSH 主题词；Task 1b 使用生物医学专家编写的英语问题，分阶段评估证据检索以及精确答案和理想摘要答案。
build_method: MEDLINE时间切分与延迟金标, 生物医学专家问答标注, 两阶段检索与作答协议
metric: Micro-F1, LCaF, MAP, GMAP, Precision, Recall, F1, Accuracy, MRR, ROUGE, Expert Scores
task_type: 生物医学语义索引, 证据检索, 精确问答, 理想答案摘要
eval_feature: 人工编目前预测MeSH, 延迟NLM金标, 问答两阶段隔离, 专家人工评价理想答案
scale: Task 1a为3批×6周动态MEDLINE测试; Task 1b含29个开发与282个测试问题
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the open-access BMC Bioinformatics 16:138 paper (PMC4450488), especially the Task 1a and Task 1b protocol sections. Task 1a training uses already indexed MEDLINE records, while each of three six-week batches draws later unlabelled MEDLINE records, gives systems 21 hours, and waits for delayed NLM labels. Task 1b Phase A exposes only question text and type while hiding official gold evidence; MAP is primary and GMAP/precision/recall/F are supplementary. Phase B primarily supplies official gold concepts, articles, snippets, and triples, while allowing a team's own Phase-A output or rerun. Factoid MRR and list mean F are primary exact-answer measures; summary questions have no exact answer. Ideal answers receive four biomedical-expert 1–5 scores, with ROUGE exploratory.
task_type_en: Question Answering, Text Summarization, Named Entity Recognition, Information Extraction
build_method_en: Temporal MEDLINE split with delayed gold labels, biomedical-expert QA annotation, two-phase retrieval and answering protocol
eval_feature_en: Pre-curation MeSH prediction, delayed NLM gold labels, isolated QA phases, expert evaluation of ideal answers
intro_en: The first BioASQ challenge contains two biomedical tasks: Task 1a predicts MeSH headings for new MEDLINE records before manual indexing, while Task 1b uses English questions written by biomedical experts to evaluate evidence retrieval followed by exact and ideal-summary answering.

flowchart LR
    M[MEDLINE timeline] --> T[Task 1a indexed training records]
    M --> U[Task 1a subsequent weekly unlabelled records]
    U --> S[Submit MeSH predictions within 21 hours]
    S --> N[Delayed NLM gold labels and Task 1a scores]
    Q[Expert-authored Task 1b questions and official gold] --> A[Phase A receives question and type only; gold hidden]
    A --> R[Retrieve concepts, articles, snippets, and triples; MAP primary]
    Q --> B[Phase B receives official gold evidence]
    R -. own Phase-A output or rerun .-> B
    B --> E[Exact answers plus ideal answers]
    E --> Z[Factoid MRR, list mean F, expert 1-5 scores, exploratory ROUGE]
scale_en: Task 1a: 3 batches of 6 weekly dynamic MEDLINE tests; Task 1b: 29 development and 282 test questions
metric_en: Micro-F1, LCaF, MAP, GMAP, Precision, Recall, F1, Accuracy, MRR, ROUGE, Expert Scores
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    M[MEDLINE records] --> T[Build Task 1a training from already indexed records]
    M --> U[Select subsequent MEDLINE records for 3 batches of 6 weekly tests]
    U --> S[Predict MeSH within 21 hours before NLM curation]
    S --> N[Wait for delayed NLM labels and score Task 1a]
    Q[Experts create Task 1b questions and full official gold] --> A[Phase A exposes question text and type only; official gold hidden]
    A --> R[Retrieve concepts, articles, snippets, and triples; MAP is primary]
    Q --> B[Phase B primarily receives official gold evidence]
    R -. team may reuse its Phase-A output or rerun .-> B
    B --> E[Produce exact answers and ideal summaries]
    E --> X[Factoid MRR and list mean F; summaries have no exact answer]
    E --> I[Four expert dimensions scored 1-5; ROUGE exploratory]
